mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in consumer spending (RSAFS decline) and housing starts (HOUST decline) signals a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply shock regime (indicated by INDPRO below 92.0), reduced output capacity leads to higher inflation expectations and tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 92.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index above 2.5% year-over-year signals rising inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 380,000 million dollars signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 380000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
